text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to push an autoscaler policy tweak to reserved-gpu-pool tonight 19:00 PT. Change: min-burst 4 -> 2, slightly more aggressive scale-up. Need a smoke lead + rollback readiness. Who can shadow?
ajay: @maria I can take smoke from 18:50 PT. share PR/commit?
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/789. artifact sha: abcdef12. Deploy will go via rollout job.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Artifact built (sha: abcdef12) from PR-789. Rollout scheduled for 2447775600 (19:00 PT).
ryan: I'll own rollback window & watch alerts. @sre-oncall can you be on pager 18:45-19:30?
sre-oncall: Oncall here — I’ll monitor. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/gpu-autoscale. Escalation chain ready.
maria: Quick smoke checklist:
- verify pool size: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=reserved-gpu`
- check pods: `kubectl get pods -n dedicated | grep reserved-gpu` before/after
- perf probe: `curl -sS https://smoke.internal/pool-check?pool=reserved-gpu`
- validate metrics in Datadog (gpu_util, queue_length)
If smoke fails -> rollback step: `kubectl apply -f /deploy/policies/reserved-gpu-policy-v2.yaml` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/reserved-gpu-controller`.
ajay: ack. I have prod creds and will run the smoke commands. Ping me when deploy starts.
alisa: product is aware — brief flakiness tolerable, but watch latency SLOs.
maria: Plan: canary 10% at 19:00, wait 10m, then full cutover at ~19:12 if healthy. Will post job ids here.
ryan: I'll set a temporary rate-limit fallback if needed. Rollback triggers: error rate >2% OR p95 latency increase >300ms sustained 5m. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started (10%) — job id deploy-2447771234-canary. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/2447771234/logs
ajay: Canary logs look normal, no errors in last 3m.
maria: Proceeding to full rollout at 19:12 PT. Posting job id when started.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout triggered. job id deploy-2447771234-full.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout complete at 19:13 PT. status: SUCCESS. artifact: abcdef12.
ryan: Verifying metrics: gpu_util stable, queue length decreased, no new alerts. Keeping a 20m watch.
sre-oncall: Pager silent. I'll close the active watch in 15m if no signals.
ajay: Smoke commands I ran (copied):
```
kubectl get pods -n dedicated | grep reserved-gpu
curl -sS https://smoke.internal/pool-check?pool=reserved-gpu | jq .status
```
All returned healthy.
maria: Awesome — no rollback required. I'll tag PR-789 as deployed and update the rollout doc with notes.
alisa: Thanks team :tada:
